comentarios: The recording contains two calls emitted by an Ortalis columbiana individual. Between the first and second note of the first call, there is an overlap with the vocalization of another bird. This Ortalis columbiana individual is located in the city of Neiva, in a temporary shelter and an aviary of the The recording is of an Ortalis columbiana individual. This individual had a deformed beak and is in recovery at the temporary shelter of the  "corporación autónoma regional del alto magdalena".
